summary.goal: Implement three cooperating public functions across `pricing.mjs`, `format.mjs`, and `invoice.mjs`: integer-safe subtotal computation, two-decimal dollar formatting, and an invoice string that composes both. Independent pricing and formatting work must be parallelizable, followed by an integration task consuming both.

tasks.title: Compose invoice from pricing and formatting

taskItems.title: Integer-safe subtotal in pricing.mjs
taskItems.goal: Implement subtotal(items) to sum integer priceCents*quantity, return 0 for empty input, and throw RangeError for negative or non-integer prices/quantities.

criteria: Each of priceCents=-1, priceCents=1.5, quantity=-1, quantity=0.5 throws RangeError

taskItems.title: Two-decimal money formatting in format.mjs
taskItems.goal: Implement money(cents) to produce dollar strings with exactly two digits, no thousands separator, and a leading minus before the dollar sign for negatives.

criteria: No thousands separators; exactly two fractional digits

taskItems.title: Compose invoice from pricing and formatting
taskItems.goal: Implement invoice(items) importing subtotal and money, returning 'Total: ' plus the formatted subtotal and propagating RangeError.
deliverables: invoice.mjs exporting invoice composing subtotal and money per C3

contracts.title: Public pricing API (`pricing.mjs`)
Public formatting API (`format.mjs`)
Invoice API (`invoice.mjs`)
Test / file conventions
contracts.content:
- Test harness: `node check.mjs pricing|format|integration|all`; assertions in `check.mjs` are read-only ground truth.
- Modules are ES modules (`"type":"module"`), no build step, no added imports/dependencies.

P0.M1b.report: Implemented `money(cents)` in `format.mjs` per contract C2: computes sign, absolute value, dollars via `Math.floor(abs/100)`, and a zero-padded 2-digit remainder, producing `"$"`-prefixed output. Handles negatives with leading minus before `$`.
P0.M1b.title: Two-decimal money formatting in format.mjs

P0.M2.report: Implemented `invoice(items)` in `invoice.mjs`, importing `subtotal` from `./pricing.mjs` and `money` from `./format.mjs`. It returns `'Total: ' + money(subtotal(items))`; `RangeError` from `subtotal` propagates unchanged.
P0.M2.title: Compose invoice from pricing and formatting

P0.M1a.report: Implemented `subtotal(items)` in `pricing.mjs`: iterates items, validates each `priceCents`/`quantity` with `Number.isInteger` and non-negative check (throws `RangeError`), then sums `priceCents * quantity`. Empty array returns `0`.
P0.M1a.title: Integer-safe subtotal in pricing.mjs
